evidence.field: 考; graphic formation and reported early uses, lines 171–179
evidence.text: The entry favors an account in which early Western Zhou bronze inscriptions used 老 for both ‘old’ and ‘father’; 丂 was added as a sound marker to distinguish 考, with the lower 匕 often omitted. It also presents a competing proposal that 丂 was first used for ‘father’ and 老 added as a classifier. The entry says early bronze use of 丂 for ‘father’ lends that proposal some support, but prefers the 老-based account for the early Western Zhou evidence. It reports 考 for ‘father’ in 兮仲鐘 and ‘consider/estimate’ in 中山王鼎, and separate phonetic uses for 孝 and 巧. The page supplies no dates for those named examples and does not establish a semantic path from ‘father’ to ‘examine/test’.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 考

evidence.text: The entry presents a small-seal form, bronze forms, oracle forms and manuscript forms under 考. It quotes 說文: ‘考，老也。从老省，丂聲’ and gives 苦浩切. The page labels the displayed categories, but does not date the individual examples in this section.

gaps: No usable image was selected: Commons’ exact 考-seal.svg description page and imageinfo API could not be inspected, and its original image request returned HTTP 429. The supplied local metadata is unverified and cannot establish current identity or rights.

Xiaoxuetang’s CC0 notice was verified, but no exact 考 query record or rendered glyph was retrieved. Its rights notice does not authorize use of a glyph that was not actually obtained and checked through the interface.

CUHK lists small-seal, bronze, oracle and manuscript forms and reports named uses, but it gives no dates for the individual examples. Earliest attestations remain unresolved; the relationship from ‘father’ or ‘consider/estimate’ to current ‘examine/test’ is not established.

limitations.text: No candidate image in this run had both an inspectable character-specific source record and verified reuse terms. The supplied Commons file lead could not be checked on its exact page, while the Xiaoxuetang rights notice was accessible but no specific 考 image was obtained. This does not establish that no suitable image exists.
